en: Sepia-toned historical view of a town square with multi-story buildings surrounding a cobblestone piazza. In the center is a decorative fountain where people gather with donkeys and carts. Several adults and children in early 20th-century clothing stand or walk across the square. The architecture is typical of an Italian alpine village, with arched porticos on the central building. The caption at the bottom identifies the location as Pieve Tesino in Trentino and names the square Piazza Maggiore.
